a: अपवादः — 1 Censuring, reviling; censure, reproach, blame, abuse; आस्तातापवादभिन्नमर्याद U. 5; लोकापवादो बलवान्मतो मे R. 14. 40; लोकापवादाद्भयं Bh. 2. 62; scandal, evil report; चिरकालान्मया श्रुतस्तवापवादः Pt. 1; Ki. 11. 25, 14. 12; Mk. 9. 3; U. 1; Pt. 4; Y. 2. 207; देव्यामपि हि वैदेह्यां सापवादो यतो जनः U. 1. 6 spreading or indulging in scandals about; न केवलभत्याहितं सापवादमपि U. 2; सापवादं censuringly Māl. 9. --2 An exception, a special rule that restricts or sets aside a general rule (opp. उत्सर्ग); मा हिंस्यात्सर्वभूतानि इति उत्सर्गः; वायव्यं श्वेतमालभेत इत्यपवादः; अपवादैरिवोत्सर्गाः कृतव्यावृत्तयः परैः Ku. 2. 27; R. 15. 7; ˚प्रत्ययः exceptional suffix; ˚स्थलं a case for a special rule. --3 An order, command; ततोपवादेन पताकिनीपतेश्चचाल निर्ह्रादवतीमहाचमूः Ki. 14. 27. --4 Refutation; (in Vedānta phil.) refutation as of a wrong imputation or belief; रज्जुविवर्तस्य सर्पस्य रज्जुमात्रत्ववत्, वस्तुभूतब्रह्मणो विवर्तस्य प्रपंचादेः वस्तुभूतरूपतोपदेशः अपवादः Tv.; अध्यारोपापवादाभ्यां वस्तुतत्त्वविनिश्चयः Vedānta; hence also, a means of refutation. --5 Confidence, trust. --6 Love; familiarity. --7 A small bell or other instrument sounded to decoy deer; मधुकरैरपवादकरैरिव Śi. 6. 9; (˚करैः = व्याधैः, अपवादं मृगवंचनाय घंटादिकुत्सितवाद्यंकुर्वंति तैः Malli.)

a: अपवद् — {c1c} U. 1 To revile, abuse, censure, reproach; परानमी यदपवदंत आत्मनः Śi. 17. 19; नार्तोप्यपवदेद्विप्रान् Ms. 4. 236; स्वं पुत्रं अपवदंति-ते वा P. I. 3. 77. Sk. I. 3. 73 Sk. --3 To argue out, refute, contradict; अपवदेयुस्तानितिहासैः पुरातनैः Y. 3. 7. --Caus. 1 To blame, censure. --2 To oppose or contradict as unadvisable.

अप-√ वह् to carry off; to deduct; to give up: Caus. -वाहयति, to have (something) carried off or taken away; to drive away, Daś.; Pañcat.
a: अपवह् — {c1c} P. 1 To carry off or away, bear off or away; अपोवाह च वासोऽस्या मारुतः Mb. --2 To drive away, disperse, dispel, remove, take away; अमी जनस्थानमपोढविघ्नं मत्वा R. 13. 22 freed from obstacles; अथानपोढार्गलमप्यगारं (प्रविष्टां) 16. 6 the bolts of which were not removed or unchained; तदुच्छिष्टमपोह्य Dk. 133. --3 To give up, relinquish, leave, abandon, cast off; शमिततापमपोढमहीरजः Śi. 6. 33; संभ्रमोऽभवदपोढकर्मणां (ऋत्विजां) R. 11. 25; तद्भक्त्यपोढपितृराज्यमहभिषेके (मूर्धनि) 13. 70 thrown away; Dk. 67; दिव्येन शून्यं वलयेन बाहुमपोढनेपथ्यविधिर्ददर्श R. 16. 73 before he had commenced his toilet. --4 To deduct, subtract. --Caus. 1 To carry off, remove, carry or draw to a distance, take away; मलयकेतुरपवाहितः Mu. 1, 3; कलत्रं 2; इमां मया सार्धमपवाह्य M. 5; Bk. 8. 86. --2 To chase or drive away, expel; हृतसर्वस्वतया अपवाहितः Dk. 47, 59. --3 To reduce to powder, pulverize. --4 To cause to carry the yoke; गामिव नासिकां विद्ध्वापवाहयति Mk. 8.

अपवर्गः — 1 Completion, end, fulfilment or accomplishment of an action; अपवर्गे तृतीया P. II. 3. 6; III. 4. 60; (अपवर्गः = क्रियाप्राप्तिः or समाप्तिः Sk.); क्रियापवर्गेष्वनुजीविसात्कृताः Ki. 1. 14; अपवर्गे तृतीयेति भणतः पाणिनेरपि N. 17. 68; Ki. 16. 49; पंच˚ coming to an end in 5 days. --2 An exception, special rule; अभिव्याप्यापकर्षणमपवर्गः Suśr. --3 Absolution, final beatitude; अपवर्गमहोदयार्थयोर्भुवमंशाविव धर्मयोर्गतौ R. 8. 16; ज्ञानेन चापवर्गः Sāṅ. K. 44 --4 A gift, donation. --5 Abandonment. --6 Throwing, discharge (as of arrows); Ki. 16. 20.

k.v: मोक्षोऽपवर्गोऽथाज्ञानमविद्याहंमतिः स्त्रियाम्. रूपं शब्दो गन्धरसस्पर्शाश्च विषया अमी॥

m: अप-वर्ग—द mf(आ)n. conferring final beatitude.
अप-वर्ग—मार्ग m. the path of emancipation, Bcar.
अप-वर्जनीय mfn. to be avoided.
अप-वर्जन n. completion, discharging a debt or obligation, Hariv.
transmitting, giving in marriage (a daughter), MBh.
(also) gift, donation, L.
final emancipation or beatitude, L.
abandoning, L.
a: अपवर्जनं — 1 Leaving, abandonment; making good, fulfilling (a promise); discharging (debt &c.). --2 A gift or donation; spending. --3 Final beatitude, salvation.

k.v: प्रादेशनं निर्वपणमपवर्जनमंहतिः। मृतार्थं तदहे दानं त्रिषु स्यादौर्ध्वदेहिकम्.।

m: अप-वर्जित mfn. abandoned, quitted, got rid of, given or cast away
made good (as a promise), discharged (as a debt).
a: अपवर्जित — p. p. Left, abandoned; fulfilled; see above; oft. in comp. in the sense of ‘free from,’ ‘being without,’ ‘destitute of’, or with instr.; षड्भिरपवर्जिताशीतिः Bṛ. S. 53. 7 80 minus 6, Ki. 2. 26.

m: अपवर्जन—वर्जित-तैलपूरapavarjita-tElapUra see तैल-प्˚ (p. 455).
अपवर्जित—तैल—पूर mfn., [Bhaktām. 15] (a lamp) that wants no oil-filling.

अप-वर्त &c. See अप-√ व्रित्.
अप-वर्त m. (in arithm. or alg.) reduction to a common measure
the divisor (which is applied to both or either of the quantities of an equation).
a: अपवर्त — &c. See under अपवृ, अपवृज्-अपवृत्.
अपवर्तः — 1 Taking away, removing. --2 (Math.) The (common) divisor which is applied to both or either of the quantities of an equation. --3 Reduction to a common measure.

m: अप-वर्तक m. a common measure, L.
a: अपवर्तकः — A common measure.

m: अप-वर्तन n. taking away, removal, Suśr.
ademption, Mn. ix, 79
reduction of a fraction to its lowest terms, division without remainder
divisor.
a: अपवर्तनं — 1 Removal, transferring from one place to another; स्थान˚. --2 Taking away, depriving one of; न त्यागोस्ति द्विषंत्याश्च न च दायापवर्तनं Ms. 9. 79. --3 Abridging, abbreviation. --4 Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms; division without remainder, or the divisor itself.

m: अप-वर्तृ m. one who opens, RV. iv, 20, 8.
अप-वर्तिका f. = नीवि, KātyŚr., Sch.
अप-वर्तित mfn. taken away
removed
divided by a common measure without remainder.

m: अप-वर्त्य mfn. to be reduced (by division) to the smallest quantity, Bīj.
अप-√ 2. वस् (Subj. -उच्छत्, Imper. -उच्छतु) to drive off by excessive brightness, RV.; AV.; to become extinct, AV. iii, 7, 7.

v: tri॰ apaH karma tadastyasya matup vede sasya lopaH । karmayukte । “apfpavAnapavAMScarureha sIdatu” aTa॰ 18, 4, 24 ।
m: अप-वत् mfn. watery, AV. xviii, 4, 24.
अप-वत् See s.v. 2. अप्.
अप-वत्स mf(आ)n. having no calf, MBh.
अप-√ वे (Imper. 2. sg. -वय) to unweave what has been woven, RV. x, 130, 1.

v: pu॰ apakfzwaH asTAnakftatvAt veDaH prA॰ ta॰ । maRInAmasTAnakfte veDane “maRInAmapaveDe ca daRqa uttamasAhasam iti” manuH ।
m: अप-वेध m. piercing anything in the wrong direction or manner (spoiling a jewel by so piercing it), Mn. xi, 286.
a: अपवेधः — Piercing through (a pearl, ruby &c.) wrongly, or in the wrong direction (and thus spoiling it).

m: अप-√ वेन् (Subj. 2. sg. -वेनस्) to turn away from, be unfavourable to, AV. iv, 8, 2.
अप-√ वेष्ट् Caus. -वेष्टयति, to strip off, PBr.

अप-√ 1. वृ (impf. 2. sg. अपावृणोस्, 3. sg. अपावृणोत्; Subj. -वरत्; aor. 2. and 3. sg. -आवर् [Padap. -अवर्], 3. sg. Ā. -अवृत; aor. Subj. 1. sg. -वम् [for वर्म्, RV. x, 28, 7], 3. sg. -वर्, 3. pl. -व्रन्, Imper. 2. sg. [in RV.] once अप वृधि and five times अपा वृधि [cf. अपा- √ 1. वृ and ib. अपा-वृत]; perf. 2. sg. -ववर्थ, 3. sg. -ववार) to open, uncover, exhibit, RV.; (ind.p. -वृत्य), ŚBr. xiv; (cf. अपा- √ 1. वृ) : Caus. -वारयति, ‘to hide, conceal’, see अप-वारित.
a: अपवृ — {c5c} U. To open, uncover, disclose, exhibit. --Caus. or {c10c} P. To cover, wrap, envelop, screen, conceal; बाहुबंधनापवारितपयोधरोद्गमां Māl. 7 covered, or concealed; विटपेनापवारितशरीरा भूत्वा Ratn. 1.

m: अप-√ वृज् Ā. -व्रिङ्क्ते (Imper. 2. sg. -वृङ्क्ष्व; Subj. 1. sg. -वृणजै; aor. P. 3. sg. अपावृक्) to turn off, drive off, AV.; ŚBr.; to tear off, AV.; (with अध्वानम्) carpere viam [BR.], RV. x, 117, 7; to leave off, determine, fulfil, ŚBr. &c.: Caus. -वर्जयति, to quit, get rid of; to sever, turn off from to transmit, bestow, grant, MBh. &c.
a: अपवृज् — {c7c} A. 1 To avert, destroy, dissipate; तमः, शत्रुं &c. --2 To tear off, pull out, take out. --3 To conclude, finish; absolve. --Caus. 1 To leave, quit, abandon, avoid; दूरापवर्जितच्छत्रैः शिरोभिः R. 17. 79 keeping the umbrellas at a (great) distance; त्वयात्महस्तेन मही मदच्युता मतंगजेन स्रगिवापवर्जिता Ki. 1. 29 abandoned, left, lost. --2 To let go, drop down, throw, pour; सुमनसो दिव्याः खेचरैरपवर्जिताः Bhāg.; करयुग्मपद्ममुकुलापवार्जितैः Śi. 13. 37. --3 To abandon, release, discharge, pay off (as debt &c.); absolve oneself from, fulfil, make good (as a promise). --4 To sever, separate, cut off; भल्लापवर्जितैस्तेषां शिरोभिः (महीं तस्तार) R. 4. 63, Ki. 17. 58 severed or cut off by arrows; इमान्यमूनीत्यपवर्जिते शनैः Ki. 8. 20 plucked. --5 To overturn; empty; Y. 3. 300. --6 To honour, respect, esteem. --7 To give, bestow, grant, present; अपवर्जितं कोशजातं Dk. 36; दक्षिणामपवर्ज्य Mb.; अपवर्जितौ वरौ Rām.

m: अप-वृक्त mfn. finished, completed.
a: अपवृक्त — p. p. Finished, ended.

m: अप-वृक्तत्व n. the having finished, KātyŚr., Sch.
अप-वृक्ति f. fulfilment, completion.
a: अपवृक्तिः — f. Fulfilment, accomplishment, completion.

m: अप-√ वृत् to turn away, depart; to move out from, get out of the way, slip off: Caus. P. (Ved. Imper. 2. sg. -वर्तया) to turn or drive away from, RV. ii, 23, 7 &c.; (in arithm.) to divide; to reduce to a common measure.
a: अपवृत् — {c1c} A. To turn back, turn away, depart; तस्मादपावर्तत दूरकृष्टा R. 6. 58; तस्मादपावर्तत कुंडिनेशः 7. 33. --Caus. 1 To turn back or away, turn aside, bend; व्यपोढपार्श्वैरपवर्तितत्रिकाः Ki. 4. 15; आसक्ततिर्यगपवर्तितदृष्टि वक्त्रं (वहंती) Māl. 1. 40. --2 (Math.) To divide (as by a common measure) without remainder; समेन केनाप्यपवर्त्य हारभाज्यौ भजेद्वा सति संभवे तु Līlā. --3 To reduce to a common measure.
अपवृतिः — f. Opening.

v: tri॰ apavarttate apa + vfta--karttari kta । samApte, “apavftte karmaRi vAmadevyagAnaM SAntyarTamiti” goBilaH । “apavftte samApte” saMskAratattve raGunandanaH ।
m: अप-वृत्त mfn. reversed, inverted, overturned; finished, carried to the end (perhaps for अप-वृक्त), ŚāṅkhŚr.; KātyŚr. &c.
badly conducted, ill-behaved, BhP.
अप-वृत्त n. (in astron.) ecliptic.
a: अपवृत्त — p. p. 1 Turned away, reversed, inverted, overturned; agitated, disturbed; ˚जठरशफरी Ki. 12. 49. --2 With downward face; व्याकीर्णस्फुरदपवृत्तरुंडखंडः Māl. 3. 17. --3 Ended, finished. --त्तं The ecliptic.

m: अप-वृत्त—भाव m. aversion, Jātakam.
अप-वृत्ति f. slipping off, end, L.
a: अपवृत्तिः — f. End.

v: tri॰ apagato viGno yasmAt । viGnaSUnye “SataM kratUnAmapaviGnamApa sa” iti raGuH ।
m: अप-विघ्न mfn. unobstructed, unimpeded
अप-विघ्न n. freedom from obstruction, MBh. i, 6875.
a: अपविघ्न — a. Unobstructed, uninterrupted; शतं क्रतूनामपविघ्नमाप सः R. 3. 38.

अप-√ विच् cl. 7. -विनक्ति (impf. अपाविनक्) to single out from, select, AV.; ŚBr.; cl. 3. -वेवेक्ति id., Kauś.

अप-विद्ध mfn. pierced
thrown away, rejected, dismissed, removed.
a: अपविद्ध — &c. See under अपव्यध्.

अपविद्ध — p. p. 1 Cast or thrown off, thrown or cast away, abandoned, forsaken, dismissed, rejected, neglected, removed; oft. used in the sense of ‘freed from,’ ‘devoid of’; रक्षोविप्रकृतावास्तामपविद्धशुचाविव R. 10. 74. --2 Abject, mean. --द्धः, ˚पुत्रः A son that is abandoned by the father or mother or by both, and adopted by a stranger; one of the 12 kinds of sons among Hindus; Ms. 9. 171; Y. 2. 132. --Comp. --लोक a. dead, departed from this world.

m: अप-विद्ध—लोक mfn. ‘who has given up the world’, dead, BhP.

puM, (apavidDaH puttraH, karmmaDArayaH,) dvAdaSaviDaputramaDye putraviSezaH । sa tu pozaRAdyasamarTamAtApitfByAM tyaktaH tayoranyataramaraRe anyatareRa vA tyaktaH anantaraM anyena gfhItvA putratvena parikalpitaH । yaTA, -- “mAtApitfByAmutsfzwaM tayoranyatareRa vA । yaM putraM parigfhRIyAdapavidDaH sa ucyate” ॥ iti manuH ॥
m: अप-विद्ध—पुत्र m. a son rejected by his natural parents and adopted by a stranger, Mn.; Yājñ.
one of the twelve objects of filiation in law.

m: अप-विद्या f. bad knowledge, ignorance, MārkP.
a: अपविद्या — Ignorance, spiritual ignorance, Māyā or illusion (अविद्या); तत्त्वस्य संवित्तिरिवापविद्यां Ki. 16. 32.

m: अप-√ विज् to start away from (acc.), AV. xii, 1, 37.
अप-विक्षत mfn. unwounded, Śāk. (v.l.)
a: अपविक्षत — a. Uninjured, unhurt, unviolated.

m: अप-विपद् mfn. free from misfortune or calamity, Nalac.

m: अ-पवित्र mf(आ)n. impure.
अ-पवित्र-डाकिनी f. a disgusting female imp, Mṛcch.

अप-विष्णु ind. except or without Viṣṇu.

a: अपविष — a. Free from poison. --षा A sort of grass with aromatic roots; Kyllingia Monocephala.
अपवोढृ — a. One who carries away or removes; Śi. 18. 64.

m: अप-√ व्रज् to go away, ĀśvŚr.

v: tri॰ apagataM vrataM SrOtAdi karmma yasya । apagata vihitakarmmaRi “anuvratAya ranDayannapavratAniti” f॰ 1, 51, 9, apavratAn “apagatakarmmaRa” iti BA॰ । “gUQaM sUryyaM tamasA'pavratena” f॰ 50, 4, 6, 1, apagatavratamasya । nazwavrate gfhItavratatyAgini tri॰ । prA॰ ta॰ । apakfzwe vrate na॰
m: अप-व्रत mfn. disobedient, unfaithful, RV.
perverse, RV. v, 40, 6
(x, 103 additional verse, =), AV. iii, 2, 6 = VS. xvii, 47.
a: अपव्रत — a. Ved. 1 Swerving from religious observances, irreligious, impious; Rv. 1. 51. 9. --2 Disobedient, unfaithful. --3 Perverse.

m: अप-व्याख्या f. false explanation, KātyŚr., Sch.
अप-व्य्-आ-√ 1. दा (see व्य्-आ- √ 1. दा), to open (the lips), ŚBr.
अप-व्याहार m. profane or bad language, KātyŚr., Sch.
अप-व्य्-आ-√ हृ (Pot. -हरेत्) to speak wrongly or unsuitably, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
अप-व्यापार mfn. having no occupation or business, L.
अप-√ व्यध् (Subj. 3. du. -विध्यताम्) to drive away, throw away, RV. vii, 75, 4, &c.; to pierce (with arrows), MBh.; to reject, neglect.
a: अपव्यध् — {c4c} P. 1 To pierce (badly); अपविद्धः शरैर्भृशं Mb. --2 To throw or cast in general, throw or cast off, toss away; प्रेंखयन् परिजनापविद्धया (दोलया) R. 19. 44 left, let go; भुजस्तंभापविद्ध Mv. 2. 33 thrown, or wielded; अपविद्धसर्वस्वा Dk. 61 given or spent away; Ki. 5. 30; Śi. 8. 37; हृदयमशरणं मे पक्ष्मलाक्ष्याः कटाक्षैरपहृतमपविद्धं पतिमुन्मूलितं च Māl. 1. 28 pierced through, distracted, overcome. --3 To abandon, leave, desert, cast off (as a child, ornaments &c.); पुरा श्मशाने स्रगिवापविध्यते Mb., Ms. 11. 41, Dk. 98, 111.

m: अप-व्यवस्थ mfn. unsettled, changing, Naiṣ.

v: pu॰ apakfzwaH SAstrAdimaryyAdAmullaNGyAsTAne kftatvAt vyayaH prA॰ ta॰ । dyUtaveSyAdAvasTAne kfte vyaye । apagataH vyayaHkzayo'sya । avinaSvare tri॰ ।
m: अप-व्यय m. (√ इ), prodigality, L.
a: अपव्ययः — [अपकृष्टः मर्यादामुल्लंघ्य कृतः व्ययः] Extravagant expenditure, prodigality, lavishness.

v: tri॰ apa + vi + aya--SAnac । apalApa karttari । “arTe'pavyayamAnantu kAraRena viBAvitam । dApayedDanikasyArTaM daRqaleSaYca Saktita iti” manuH । apavyayamAnamapalapantamiti di॰ ta॰ raGu॰ । apavyayakarttari tri॰ ।

a: अपव्ययिन् --व्ययमान — a. 1 Squandering, spending lavishly, prodigal. --2 Denying a debt.

m: अप-√ व्ये P. Ā. -व्ययति (1. sg. -व्यये) to uncover, RV. vii, 81, 1; AV. : Ā. (pr. p. -व्ययमान) to extricate one's self, deny, Mn.
